summary: High Tide Inc. filed a Form 6-K on July 10, 2026, attaching a new Shareholder Rights Plan Agreement and an Amended and Restated Shareholder Rights Plan Agreement with Olympia Trust Company, effective June 26, 2026. The plan is a poison pill designed to ensure fair treatment of shareholders in any take-over bid and maintain compliance with cannabis laws. It does not replace the existing plan from April 2025 but adds an additional layer of defense. No specific acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign is disclosed. The filing is a routine adoption of an anti-takeover measure and does not represent a change-of-control transaction. What to watch: any triggering event that would cause the rights to become exercisable.
